title: Form-to-Sheet Automation
summary: Google Form responses land in a formatted sheet without breaking formulas, plus an automatic summary report.
result: Zero manual copy-paste: every response lands in the right row and a PDF summary goes out every Monday.
note: Demo built with fictitious order-request data. Time saved is estimated for about 20 form responses a day.

screenshots.alt: Orders sheet: a new form response written into the formatted table, formulas and dropdowns intact
Weekly PDF summary generated and emailed every Monday by Apps Script

upworkBlurb: Google Forms to Google Sheets automation with Apps Script: every response is cleaned and written into a formatted sheet without breaking formulas, dropdowns or formatting, the thing the default form link always breaks. A weekly summary is exported as a PDF and emailed every Monday. No add-ons or paid tools. Saves about 3 hours a week of copy-paste (estimate). Demo uses fictitious data. Stack: Google Forms, Google Sheets, Apps Script, Gmail.

pt.title: Automação de Formulário para Planilha

pt.note: Demonstração feita com pedidos fictícios. O tempo economizado é uma estimativa para cerca de 20 respostas por dia.
